title: Prove.
tagline: Prove is an AVS based ZK proving marketplace for power users.
description: Prove. is an AVS based ZK proving market built for users who wants to run any zk based computation. They simply create a task with the required input data and other time / budget requirements. The task is then matched with a prover who obtains a proof the given input and submits to the AVS network. The validators then validate the proof and in case the prover is found malicious, he is slashed.
how_its_made: The AVS stack is built on the top of Othentic Lab's JS/TS engine. The user can specify the budget and required generation time for the proof generation, and he is matched with a prover by the task performer (from the AVS stack). There is also a escrow smart contract that handles the fees settlement after the task is completed and validated. A small percentage of the fees is sent to the validators and a chunk goes to the prover.
